limits.weather: Three illustrative sampling cells, not weighted regional crop-area averages; no validated yield-response calibration or live forecast. Historical baseline 2015–2023 (nine years), not a WMO 30-year normal.
limits.production: Historical reports and certification evidence. Registration/inspection/approval areas are not harvested output. Cleaning and marketability remain explicit assumptions.
limits.trade: Stage 1 monthly 2026 trade remains contextual. No automatic species allocation of CN groups, annualisation, or joining a 2026 month to 2024 production.
limits.non_certified: No measured farm-saved/non-certified addition; optional explicitly incremental scenario only. No addition of certified quantity to total estimated harvest.

matched_trade.definition: Official WORLD partner aggregate only; 12 matched marketing-year months; national imports include intra-EU arrivals, national exports include intra-EU dispatches. Never added to EU-wide supply. No sum of WORLD plus bilateral partners. 100 kg / 10 = tonnes.
